title: Bakery Franchise Opportunity
name: Cake Pop, 1 Franchisee, Est'd in 2026, Kushinagar HQ
description: Cake Pop Retails Pvt. Ltd. is a bakery and dessert brand offering a modern franchise opportunity for entrepreneurs. - The brand offers a wide range of fresh bakery and dessert products, including cakes, birthday cakes, custom cakes, bento cakes, cake pops, cupcakes, brownies, pastries, donuts, dessert cups, and cookies. - The beverage range includes hot coffee, cold coffee, milkshakes, and hot chocolate. - The brand also caters to celebration and institutional requirements through celebration combos, birthday party orders, and corporate orders. - The franchise model is designed as an affordable and structured format for entrepreneurs looking to establish a modern bakery outlet. - Franchise partners receive support for outlet setup, product training, operations, and marketing. - The business focuses on product quality, attractive presentation, affordable pricing, and customer experience. - The franchise opportunity is positioned to benefit from demand for cakes, desserts, celebration products, and convenient bakery offerings. - Holds an FSSAI license.
